name: Invoct – PDF Invoices & Billing for WooCommerce
author: Kiril Kirkov

sections.description:
Invoct is a powerful Invoice Generator for WordPress — designed to work standalone or seamlessly with WooCommerce. Whether you need to automate periodic invoicing or accept Stripe payments directly, this plugin provides a robust solution for your business.

📌 Key Features included:

  • Multiple Document Types: Create Pro-Forma, Invoices, Debit notes, and Credit notes.
  • WooCommerce Integration: Automatically generate PDF invoices for every order.
  • Standalone Mode: Use it as a full-featured invoicing system without WooCommerce.
  • Professional Templates: Choose from various professionally designed layouts.
  • Periodic Invoicing: Automate your billing cycle and never miss a payment.
  • Effortless Calculations: Automatic amount calculation including VAT and taxes.
  • Stripe Payments: Unique payment links for your invoices (Available in Pro).
  • PDF Generation: One-click download and generation of high-quality PDF files.
  • Analytics Dashboard: Visual reports and stats for your issued invoices.
  • Export Options: Export your data to CSV for accounting purposes.
  • API Integration: Connect with other services (Available in Pro).

Manage your clients, products, and currency exchange with an intuitive and modern interface.

Source code of used js libraries:

  • ChartJS – https://github.com/chartjs/Chart.js
  • MathJS – https://github.com/josdejong/mathjs
  • kurkle/color – https://github.com/kurkle/color
  • Select2 – https://github.com/select2/select2

The link is displayed in the plugin’s admin interface to inform users about
the availability of additional features in the premium version. No data is sent

sections.installation:
1. Install “Invoice Generator for WordPress & WooCommerce – PDF & Periodic Invoices” from the WordPress Plugin Directory. Or, if that doesn’t work:
  2. Unzip the plugin file and move it to the directory of your WordPress plugins – “wp-content/plugins”.
  3. In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins and activate “Invoice Generator for WordPress & WooCommerce – PDF & Periodic Invoices”
sections.faq:
Does this work without WooCommerce?

Yes! The plugin works perfectly as a standalone invoicing system or with WooCommerce.

Is Stripe payment integration available?

Stripe payments are available in the Premium (Pro) version of the plugin.
